تخترعي (form VIII)
# تَخْتَرِعِي (taḵtariʕī) /tax.ta.ri.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
# تُخْتَرَعِي (tuḵtaraʕī) /tux.ta.ra.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
